title: The sequencing chain's instruments checked one by one; each type judged against its own healthy level
set_out: Finish the sequencing work: every sequencing instrument wired in and checked on a known-answer library, IAM-A's per-type band compared like for like, A8 defended by its measured substitute until it can be derived; document everything.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Per-type band against band v2, like for like (COM-IAMA-054)
entries.what: 152 atlas libraries, each scored against bands rebuilt without its donor stand-in (GEO lab, age, sex).
entries.outcome: Per-type band 113 of 123 inside at +/-8.5 %, flags an 8.5 % rise in every type; band v2's pooled rule 115 of 123, flags 0.7-46.9 % by type and misses whole healthy types.
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (GSE186458), A_derived from the one-button joint run
